thread:
Ava (CEO): Quick heads-up — all-hands this Wednesday 10:00am PT in main room. Plan is ~45m + 15m open Q&A. High-level agenda below, please drop short questions in thread or the form (link).

Priya (People Ops): Agenda weaved: 1) Exec updates & hires, 2) Product launch callouts (Dedicated beta), 3) Policy update: data retention defaults, 4) Incident recap (last week's cache storm), 5) Ops metrics highlight, 6) Q&A. Can speakers ping me for time slots.

Jonas (Product): I'll do the Dedicated beta callout — 7min demo + rollout plan. Will surface migration checklist.

Maya (Eng): I'll cover the cache-storm postmortem summary — 5min. TL;DR: root cause in autoscaler burst policy, mitigated by rate-limited warmups.

Sam (Eng-SRE): Heads-up: I'll show 95/99 latency delta charts and SLO changes for the quarter. Need a slot right after Maya.

Kate (Comms): Recording + transcript will be posted to #all-hands-resources after. I'll share a 1-pager summary and the slide deck.

Priya (People Ops): Q&A collection — use this form: https://forms.company/ah-questions or drop a short question here. Please prefix with "Q:" so we can triage. Example: Q: Will Dedicated beta support multi-tenant configs?

DevBot: Calendar invite posted: <https://calendar.company/evt/1809998765|All-hands — Wed 10am PT> :bell:

Sam (Eng-SRE): Q: can we have the new SLO targets in the deck? Also request: include per-region latency for EU/US in 1 slide.

Ava (CEO): Yes — add that, Sam. We'll call out the SLA commitments for Dedicated customers and the plan for private deployments.

Jonas (Product): Note re: launch callouts — marketing will run a coordinated blog + docs sync. We'll show migration playbook link during the call.

Priya (People Ops): Logistics: please keep slides to 6-8 slides per speaker; speakers should coordinate with me if they need >10 minutes. Childcare-friendly note: recording will be available for those in APAC.

Maya (Eng): For the incident recap I'll paste a short snippet in the doc: ```Root cause: aggressive autoscaler warmup; Fix: added rate limiter + circuit-breaker; Followups: long-term autoscaler policy review```.

Kate (Comms): Reminder: if you reference customer examples, redact PII and follow the disclosure checklist: https://docs.company/release/comms-checklist.

DevBot: :thumbsup: Speaker roster updated: Jonas (7m), Maya (5m), Sam (6m), Pricing/Product ops (5m), Ava (10m exec).

Priya (People Ops): Please submit questions by Tuesday EOD to help prioritize. We'll put top Qs on the live q&a board.

Sam (Eng-SRE): Small ask: can we add a one-slide demo of automatic fallback behavior when Dedicated capacity saturates? It's relevant to the SLA talk.

Jonas (Product): Good call — adding it.

Ava (CEO): One more: we'll announce the new data retention default policy: rolling retention reduced from 90 -> 30 days for non-enterprise hosted accounts to lower storage costs and compliance surface. We'll call out enterprise exceptions and private deployment options.

Priya (People Ops): We'll include a FAQ blurb in the post-all-hands summary. If you're impacted (internal teams), please flag ASAP — we need migration plans for Audit/Compliance teams.

Kate (Comms): Post-hands share will include: recording link, slide deck, FAQ, follow-up actions, owner list. Expect email + #all-hands-resources post within 24h.

Ava (CEO): TL;DR takeaways to emphasize during call: 1) Dedicated beta timeline & customer migration plan, 2) new data retention default + enterprise options, 3) reliability improvements from incident fixes, 4) measurable SLO adjustments and what they mean for product teams.

Priya (People Ops): Final logistical note: we will run the Q&A in two lanes — live and pre-submitted. Pre-submitted get priority.

DevBot: Recording (to be posted): https://recordings.company/1809998765 — will be live after the meeting.

Sam (Eng-SRE): Thanks — will add a short ops checklist to the shared drive. Link posted after slides ready.

Jonas (Product): Quick ask: can product PMs please add any customer-facing notes to the launch doc by Tuesday noon?

Ava (CEO): Thanks everyone. See you Wednesday 10am PT. Encouraging brevity on slides — keep it sharp.

Kate (Comms) (post-meeting): Recording: https://recordings.company/1809998765 (live). Summary doc: https://docs.company/all-hands/1809998765-summary — includes FAQ, action owners, and slide deck. Key takeaways posted in doc header.

Priya (People Ops) (post-meeting): Action items condensed: - Jonas: finalize migration checklist (owner) - Maya: schedule autoscaler policy review (owner) - Sam: publish SLO slide pack (owner) - Kate: publish comms package (owner) Deadline: next Wed EOD.

Ava (CEO) (post-meeting): Appreciate the focused discussion. Noting commitment: we will publish a short explainer for the data retention policy targeted at customers and internal teams within 72 hours.

DevBot (post-meeting): Meeting ended: duration 58m. Reactions: :clap: :eyes: :rocket:
